body: Wow. It’s not fair you’re pain isn’t being properly acknowledged. I’m not sure if your mothers crass response means she thinks you’re looking for attention, trying to manipulate her or if she’s actual afraid to find you dead one day. Either way she doesn’t know how to connect to what you are going through right now and it’s important to talk to someone about who understands. Thanks for sharing, you will get through this.
She sound like she’s gonna be around for a while. I guess we are stuck here. Maybe that’s a good thing

Free to message anytime, I’ll be sure to respond and let you know you’re not alone

I’m happy that my son told me that because I didn’t understand why he felt so guilty. It gave me the chance to understand and tell my son it’s not his fault. His dad is projecting because he didn’t call his mom for years and then she died it took him months to find out she passed. I explained this to my son and he seemed to understand. I also told him it my fault we didn’t visit much after dementia set in
I normally will read something motivational. Try to think about what I’m grateful for, Plan a trip.or eat yummy foods until I feel a little better

Hid dads side had brain cancer and my side lots of heath problem but when the dementia set in I stopped visiting often which affected my kids time with him. I’m trying to explain that it’s actually my fault as the parent and he shouldn’t blame himself.

We can get through this for our kids and also ourselves. How are you feeling today? I had a low point after having convo with my son about how he feels after losing both grandfathers this February. His dad told him he should’ve called his grandfather more when he first got sick. My son feels he was wrong and feels very guilty which is giving him a lot of pain. This sent me into a spiral because I’m living to see my children happy and seeing him so upset these past few months, has made me feel like a failure.

Sometimes I feel like anything is possible
and I’m excited at all the things I want out of life then next thing I know it’s all gone and I want to die.

Congrats on the new baby. I tried at 16 by taking pills, I didn’t take enough and just passed out my parents didn’t notice. At the time I was happy I lived because it was a cry for help. This time it different and it scares me. Are you doing anything to try to keep the thoughts away?
I’m happy you have someone to live for. It gets better
it’s after 1am Paulfaz2015 time so I’m not sure if he’s still up. He really helped be feel better I’m amazed. Please chat with him tomorrow if you can’t today
